title: Student journey audit: local validation complete
summary: Placement continuation and course switching verified. All 444 tests and nine grouped browser checks pass; live-account and physical-device acceptance remain outstanding.

changes.detail: Verified that selected placement order and active course checkpoints remain consistent without granting completion or mastery.
Six-scenario regression coverage, current-build browser automation, inspected screenshots, button inventory and a detailed evidence/limitations report.
Corrected a TypeScript union membership check and isolated the new test fixtures so test records cannot leak between cases.

validation.name: Automated tests
validation.detail: Final full run: 444 passed, zero failed, zero skipped. Earlier harness and source-integrity failures were repaired; original logs retained.

validation.name: TypeScript and focused ESLint
validation.detail: tsc --noEmit and ESLint on both modified application services passed. CJS tests are excluded by repo ESLint and were executed by Node.

validation.name: Web export and browser
validation.detail: Fresh Expo web export; nine grouped checks, zero captured page errors. Actual quiz/placement UI interactions, reload persistence, offline note recovery, five tab destinations, Arabic/English text and 320/390/768/1280 lesson widths.

validation.name: History integrity
validation.detail: Append-only history check passed before this follow-up; final append integrity is checked separately after writing it.

validation.name: Evidence limits
validation.detail: Authentication responses were simulated in an isolated browser. No live credentials, production cloud restore, physical devices, multi-week real session renewal, prolonged offline token expiry or exhaustive secondary-button traversal. No deployment. See the audit report for the full matrix.
